summary: Readable format-aware previews, complete compact readers, rendered proposal comparisons and direct Draft Changes editing verified through user-visible workflows and independent MCP persistence readback.

checks.title: Complete desktop and compact item readers
checks.detail: Long-list selection opens a complete reader with rendered body, exact source, ordered criteria, parameters, links and source relationships; compact return preserves the originating item, filters, scroll and selection without writing.

checks.title: Save and return to the editing entry point
checks.detail: Requirements regression saves retain their Draft working context. Direct, detail-reader and batch edits begun in Changes return to the saved proposal/item. Live destination reconciliation and atomic retries remain guarded.

checks.title: Format-aware, safe reading and source fidelity
checks.detail: Markdown/HTML excerpts derive from sanitized semantic content; plain text retains literal markup and whitespace. Unicode word/grapheme boundaries, tables, code identifiers, comparison symbols, long content and diagram-only alternatives are covered. Shared reader/preview sanitization and diagram failure regressions pass.

checks.title: Rendered proposal review with exact source differences
checks.detail: Complete before/after bodies are visible by default for body, non-body and whitespace-only changes. Added/deleted sides, pending/Applied/Rejected contexts and each saved format/revision are tested. Exact field source differences remain separately accessible.

checks.title: Direct Changes authoring, focus and protected recovery
checks.detail: Pointer and keyboard edits of Added, Edited and Information items preserve exact source and untouched rich fields through independent MCP readback/reload. Clean cancel, dirty cancel/discard, compact/detail/batch paths, remote edit/deletion/submission, validation failure, offline retry and acknowledged-save/remote-review races pass without accepted/frozen/evidence or unrelated-proposal mutations.

checks.title: Executed rendering and authoring release verification
checks.detail: 140 automated checks, 53 distinct browser checks across prior regression and final BL-012 suites, TypeScript and Worker build pass. Local browser flows use real D1 and independently authenticated MCP reads/writes. Built Worker repeat reported separately; no hosted OAuth or remote Git verification is claimed.

combined_browser.note: Includes the initial eight-check BL-012 suite and 42 checks across rich content, authoring, lifecycle, guidance and live synchronization.

final_bl012_browser.note: Expanded ten scenarios plus parent check, rerun after final review-token and focus fixes. Supersedes the initial eight-check BL-012 run.

built_worker_browser.note: Same final BL-012 suite repeated against the built Cloudflare Worker; separate authenticated MCP process shares local D1.

limits: Executed in isolated local QA projects with loopback sign-in emulation, not a hosted OAuth expiration/revocation certification.
Implementation commit references identify the pushed Site source; they do not prove external Git repository reachability.
Read-only previews and lifecycle metadata do not change verification outcomes.
